death.cause_text: You bled to death. Teeth close on your forearm and tear.
last_turns: You shoulder the back door and the alley opens up, grey and wet.
Something moves behind the dumpster. It is already on you.
The pressure on the arm goes loose, and then everything does.
truth_reveal: In the Rear alley: one of the dead.
You never saw it: Mara Voss: Bar the back door — "keep them out, whatever it costs"
willis: Ha! Oh, that was beautiful. Do it again.
"I go see what the noise is." That's what you went with. Incredible.
You opened a door in a world full of the dead to find out what the noise was. The noise was lunch. You were lunch.
Anyway. Coffee's getting cold. Go on, try again. I'll be watching.
